items.title: Your first HYROX: pace it properly
items.summary: Going too hard on run one is the quickest way to pay for it at the sled push.
items.take: Your first race isn't about a PB. Finish strong, learn what your body can do, then build from there.

items.title: Do the things you're not good at
items.summary: Prioritising three or four runs each week turned harder miles into easier, quicker work.
items.take: Progress comes from giving the weak point proper attention, not avoiding it.

items.title: Performance first. Process always.
items.summary: Strength, confidence and longevity come before chasing a number on the scales.
items.take: When the foundations are solid, results become the by-product of doing things properly.
